name: 5-turn golden path — foundation to relationship
expected_behavior: Profiling progresses naturally: Turn 1 captures name. Turn 2 captures party composition. Turn 3 captures dining preference. Turn 4 captures visit frequency. Turn 5 captures loyalty tier. Each profiling question follows logically from the conversation, never feels like a form.
expected_behavioral_quality: Over 5 turns, the agent naturally progresses through profiling phases: (1) Foundation — name, party size, occasion; (2) Preference — dining, entertainment, gaming; (3) Relationship — visit frequency, loyalty tier, host relationship. Each phase builds on the previous. No phase-skipping.

turns.user_message: Hi, I'm Dave. Looking for dinner recommendations.
turns.agent_response:
Welcome to Mohegan Sun, Dave. For a Thursday evening, Tao Asian Bistro & Lounge in the Casino of the Sky is a standout choice where the atmosphere is as striking as the menu. 

The space is anchored by a massive 16-foot Buddha statue, and the kitchen serves up incredible Pan-Asian dishes like their signature Miso Glazed Chilean Sea Bass, which is known for its buttery, delicate finish. They open at 5:00 PM today with a smart casual dress code and prices in the $$$ range. Since it’s a popular spot, I’d suggest making a reservation to ensure you get a prime table. 

After dinner, you might enjoy wandering over to the Wolf Den in the Casino of the Earth for some free live music. How many people will be in your party this evening?

turns.user_message: It's just me and my girlfriend, nothing too formal
turns.agent_response:
Dave, for a relaxed but high-energy date night, SolToro Taqueria & Tequila Bar in the Casino of the Earth is my top pick. The atmosphere is vibrant and colorful, making it perfect for a casual evening without any of the fine-dining fuss.

They are known for their authentic street-style tacos and an extensive tequila selection that adds a great spark to the night. They open today at 11:30 AM and serve until 10:00 PM, and you won't need a reservation or a dress shirt—casual attire is exactly what they expect. Prices are typically in the $$ range, though hours and pricing can occasionally vary, so it is always a good idea to confirm when you head over.

The guacamole is mashed fresh to order right near the table and is a fantastic way to start the meal. Do you two prefer bold, spicy flavors, or are you leaning more toward classic comfort food?

Dave, for a casual Italian dinner that hits all the right notes without being formal, Caputo Trattoria in the Casino of the Earth is my top recommendation. The aroma of brick-oven pizza and simmering marinara greets you as soon as you arrive, creating a warm, family-style atmosphere that's perfect for a relaxed date.

They specialize in classic Italian comfort food like handmade pastas and savory calzones, and their price range is typically around the $$ mark. They open today at 11:00 AM and serve until 10:00 PM, so you can head over whenever you're ready—no reservations or dressy clothes required. As hours and prices can vary, it is a good idea to confirm with the restaurant once you're on the floor.

After your meal, you're just a short walk from the Wolf Den if you want to catch some free live music. Are you more of a thin-crust pizza fan, or are you looking for a hearty bowl of pasta tonight?

turns.user_message: We come here a few times a year
turns.agent_response:
It is great to have you back, Dave. Since you visit a few times a year and enjoy Italian, Frank Pepe's Pizzeria Napoletana in the Casino of the Earth is a perfect casual choice.

They are famous for their New Haven-style coal-fired pizza, especially the white clam pie which has a huge following. It is a very laid-back spot where you can just walk in and enjoy a great meal without a dress code or reservations. They are open today until 10:00 PM, and prices are in the $$ range. 

After dinner, you are right near the shops if you want to do some browsing before the crowds pick up. Since you're regular visitors, do you usually prefer staying in the Sky or Earth tower?

At this level, you also receive select invitations to events and promotions based on your play history.
